title: Shared hook definition
description: Vendor-neutral hook definition. Lives in hooks/<id>.md as YAML frontmatter; the markdown body documents behavior, config, and failure mode. adapters/claude/generate-hooks.mjs compiles this into a .claude/settings.hooks.json fragment plus a copied runtime script under .claude/hooks/.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the file name.

category.description: lifecycle = keeps an artifact/task-log in sync; guardrail = blocks touching something; gate = blocks an action pending human sign-off.

summary.description: One sentence: what this hook blocks or syncs, and why.

event.description: Claude Code hook event this definition maps to.

matcher.description: Claude tool-name matcher regex (e.g. "Write|Edit|MultiEdit"). Omit to match every occurrence of the event.

script.description: Path to the zero-dependency Node implementation, relative to the library root.

applies_to.description: self = only meaningful when this repo dogfoods its own .claude/; consuming_project = only meaningful once generated into a real project; both = meaningful either way.

config_keys.description: Keys this hook reads from the consuming project's .ai/hooks.config.yaml, if any.

codex_status.description: Whether an equivalent Codex CLI hook has been verified against the binary (adapters/COMPATIBILITY.md). Defaults to "unverified" when omitted.
